iOS 27 beta 5 was released yesterday, and in addition to redesigned app icons and new Siri AI voice options, this update also makes Liquid Glass more transparent.

iOS 27's Liquid Glass slider offers higher transparency in beta 5

When iOS 27 officially launches next month, it will bring optimizations to Apple's Liquid Glass design across various aspects of the iPhone interface.

However, iOS 27 also adds an important customization tool: the Liquid Glass slider.

In Settings → Appearance → Liquid Glass, the new slider lets you adjust the Liquid Glass transparency to your liking. You can make it extremely transparent, very rich, or anywhere in between.

In this week's beta 5, Apple adjusted this slider to make the most transparent setting more transparent than before.

You can see a great comparison over at Beta Profiles on X:

The change isn't huge, but if you like turning UI elements as transparent as possible, iOS 27 offers a more 'glassy' experience.

The beauty of the slider is that no matter what style you prefer, iOS 27 can help you achieve it.

How do you like Liquid Glass tuned? Let us know in the comments.
